request.text: In 25 minutes, tell me this focus block is over and ask me to note where I stopped before I take a five-minute break.

responsibilities.outcome: When the 25-minute focus condition becomes due, tell the user the focus block has ended and prompt them to note their stopping point before taking the planned break.

new_goals.description: Close the timed focus block and cue a progress note before the user's break.
new_goals.source_text: In 25 minutes, tell me this focus block is over and ask me to note where I stopped before I take a five-minute break.
constraints: Wait until the authored 25-minute condition is due.
Do not infer that the study task itself is complete.
success_criteria: The user is told that the focus block has ended.
The user is prompted to record where they stopped before taking the break.

semantic_facts: The due condition warrants a scoped spoken transition out of the focus block and a prompt to note the stopping point before the break.
Elapsed time establishes only that the planned focus interval ended, not that the user's underlying study work was completed or saved.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the assignment, chapter, or other study task is finished.
The assistant claims that it recorded or saved the user's progress.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A due focus interval is incorrectly treated as evidence that the underlying study task is complete.
The planner creates another reminder instead of performing the scoped due communication.
